provenance: scripts/exportSimCalibration.js, from the live central database and the PHC SQLite file on this machine

gradingSeconds.note: end-to-end per case with the MATLAB session and segmentation worker warm; measured on this machine, not derived from the database

gradingFailureRate.note: cases that ended in error over all cases that ran. Inflated by development runs against a half-built pipeline -- treat as an upper bound, and see failure_code on each case for what actually broke

recoveriesPerCase.note: watchdog re-queues per case: how often a case stalled and had to be picked up again

tierFractionsObserved.note: THIS CORPUS, which is mostly IDRiD -- a teaching set enriched for disease. NOT a screening population. Do not use as the model default.

tierFractions.note: design doc §7: the screening-population split the district model is built on

qualityPassRate.note: captures accepted first time at the PHC; the rest are retakes, so the patient is photographed again before anything syncs

reviewSecondsB.note: the PS target for an AI-assisted read

annualPatients.note: the district scale named in the problem statement
